profile.name: Odin探测器数据写出节点
profile.description: Odin探测器数据写出节点是与高速科学探测器配套的数据采集与存储单元，用于在实验过程中接收连续曝光产生的帧数据，按采集顺序写出并跟踪已写入索引，便于后续流式处理与分析。
profile.description_en: An Odin detector data writer node is a data acquisition and storage unit used with high-speed scientific detectors. During experiments it receives frame data from successive exposures, writes them in acquisition order, and tracks written indices for downstream streaming and analysis.

registry.name: Diamond Light Source Writing
registry.description: Odin Writer是由Diamond Light Source生产的后处理设备，主要功能包括关闭、打开。支持Signal, Slot, collect stream docs等操作。
